description: This bar chart illustrates the difference in percentage points between two models, mBERT and XLM-R, across different hidden layer configurations. The horizontal axis represents the model configurations, labeled “hidden:[50], linear”, “hidden:[100], ReLU”, and “hidden:[50, 50], ReLU”, presented in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “% point difference”, displays a linear scale ranging from -0.2 to 0.2, with tick marks at intervals of 0.05.  For each configuration, two bars are presented side-by-side: a light blue bar representing mBERT and a dark blue bar representing XLM-R. For the “hidden:[50], linear” configuration, the mBERT bar extends to approximately 0.08, while the XLM-R bar extends to approximately -0.04.  For the “hidden:[100], ReLU” configuration, the mBERT bar reaches approximately 0.02, and the XLM-R bar reaches approximately -0.14. Finally, for the “hidden:[50, 50], ReLU” configuration, the mBERT bar extends to approximately -0.12, and the XLM-R bar extends to approximately 0.03. The bars are grouped by configuration, with each model’s performance shown for that specific configuration. No bars are visually emphasized.
